title: WebSocket endpoint for low-latency video streaming and telemetry
description: Implement api/ws_stream.py providing WebSocket endpoint at /ws/stream to broadcast encoded JPEG video frames along with real-time detection telemetry (eye state, closed probabilities, blink rate, alert stage, FPS).
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket endpoint accepts connection and handles graceful disconnects
Transmits JSON payloads containing base64 JPEG or binary image alongside structured telemetry object
Operates at target 15-30 FPS without accumulating frame lag or leaking memory
Sends monitoring unavailable message when camera is inactive or face is occluded
Unit tests verify WebSocket handshake, message structure, and clean client disconnect

steps.details: Create websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket) managing connection lifecycle and active client sets.

steps.description: Implement streaming loop with bounded frame rate
steps.details: Fetch latest frame and telemetry from VisionEngine/CameraService, encode frame to JPEG (quality ~70 for low latency), and send JSON message with image data and telemetry.

steps.description: Handle client disconnects and exceptions cleanly
steps.details: Catch WebSocketDisconnect and ensure no lingering thread or resource leaks.
Create tests/test_ws_stream.py verifying WebSocket connection, receipt of telemetry message structure, and graceful closure.

technicalNotes: Drop older frames when WebSocket connection backpressure occurs to maintain real-time latency.
Keep payload size lean (bounded JPEG resolution e.g. 640x480 or 480x360).
